evals.prompt: Implement the core_model (Silver) stage transformation from raw Bronze event data with Pydantic boundary validation using Polars.
evals.expected_output: A pure, deterministic transformation function that cleans and deduplicates raw events into a typed Pydantic core model using Polars lazy evaluation.
assertions: Separates transformation logic from orchestration and I/O adapters
Uses Pydantic models for explicit schema validation at layer boundaries
Employs Polars or DuckDB with lazy execution before sink writing
Transformation is pure, deterministic, and idempotent
Raw source records are treated as immutable

evals.prompt: Implement an idempotent data writer port and DuckDB adapter for business_view datasets with chunk size limits.
evals.expected_output: A protocol-based DataWriterPort in application/port and an idempotent DuckDB writer adapter in infrastructure/adapter.
assertions: Defines DataWriterPort using typing.Protocol in the application layer
Infrastructure adapter implements atomic or idempotent writes to prevent duplicates on retry
Applies hard compute bounds (CHUNK_SIZE or LIMIT) during reads or writes
Adapter is injected via dependency injection rather than instantiated within the stage
